name: Pediatric Perspectives
tagline: Eye Care from Birth to Teens
description: Infant and child eye exams, amblyopia, strabismus screening, refractive development, school vision, myopia control, congenital anomalies, and developmental vision.

episodes.title: Infant Eye Exam: The First Six Months
episodes.description: Red reflex, fixation, and the acuity cards — what to check and when to refer in the baby eye exam.

episodes.title: Visual Development: The Milestones from Birth to School Age
episodes.description: The normal timeline of acuity, stereopsis, and color development — and the red flags that demand attention.

episodes.title: The Preschool Exam: When Cooperation Is the Challenge
episodes.description: Matching acuity tests to age, the fix-and-follow technique, and the cycloplegic refraction that reveals truth.

episodes.title: Cycloplegic Refraction in Children: Why and How
episodes.description: Choosing cyclopentolate versus atropine, the timing of the drop, and the refraction technique that follows.

episodes.title: Amblyopia: The Lazy Eye and the Critical Period
episodes.description: The sensitive period, anisometropic versus strabismic amblyopia, and why early intervention is everything.

episodes.title: Amblyopia Treatment: Patching, Atropine, and the PEDIG Evidence
episodes.description: Dosing hours, the atropine penalty alternative, and the stopping rules from PEDIG trials.

episodes.title: Refractive Amblyopia: The Plus and the Cylinder Thresholds
episodes.description: When hyperopia and astigmatism trigger amblyopia and the prescribing thresholds that guide intervention.

episodes.title: Strabismus Screening: The Cover Test in Children
episodes.description: Detecting tropias and phorias in a wiggly child and the prism measurement that quantifies the deviation.

episodes.title: Esotropia: Congenital, Accommodative, and Acquired
episodes.description: The infantile ET versus the high-plus accommodative ET and the very different management of each.

episodes.title: Exotropia: Intermittent and Constant
episodes.description: The intermittent XT that decompensates, the convergence insufficiency overlap, and the surgical threshold.

episodes.title: Congenital Cataract: The Red Reflex Emergency
episodes.description: The leukocoria that demands urgent referral, the surgery timing window, and the amblyopia that follows.

episodes.title: Retinopathy of Prematurity: Screening and Staging
episodes.description: The gestational age and weight criteria for screening, the zone and stage system, and the treatment thresholds.

episodes.title: Pediatric Glaucoma: The Buphthalmos and the Haab Striae
episodes.description: The cloudy cornea, the enlarged eye, and the urgent surgical pathway for congenital glaucoma.

episodes.title: Nasolacrimal Duct Obstruction: The Tearing Infant
episodes.description: The massage technique, the infection that complicates, and the probing age that resolves most cases.

episodes.title: Pink Eye in Children: Viral, Bacterial, and Allergic
episodes.description: Distinguishing the three, the school exclusion rules, and the antibiotic stewardship conversation.

episodes.title: Pediatric Uveitis: The Silent Inflammation of JIA
episodes.description: The JIA screening schedule, the asymptomatic anterior uveitis, and the steroid-sparing escalation.

episodes.title: Leukocoria: The Differential Beyond Cataract
episodes.description: Retinoblastoma, Coats disease, persistent fetal vasculature — the sight- and life-threatening causes.

episodes.title: Retinoblastoma: The Life-Threatoning White Pupil
episodes.description: The red reflex asymmetry, the urgent imaging, and the oncology pathway that follows.

episodes.title: School Vision Screening: What It Catches and Misses
episodes.description: The distance acuity screen, the near and color gaps, and the hyperopia that hides until the classroom demands.

episodes.title: Learning-Related Vision Problems: The Evidence
episodes.description: The reading difficulty referral, the vision therapy debate, and the multidisciplinary approach.

episodes.title: Convergence Insufficiency: The Near Vision Struggle
episodes.description: The near point of convergence, the exophoria at near, and the pencil push-up versus office-based VT.

episodes.title: Color Vision Deficiency in Children: Genetics and Counseling
episodes.description: The X-linked inheritance, the Ishihara screen, and the career counseling that follows the diagnosis.

episodes.title: Pediatric Myopia: The Onset and the Risk Factors
episodes.description: The axial elongation, the near-work and outdoor time evidence, and the lifestyle counseling.

episodes.title: Myopia Control: Atropine, Ortho-K, and Dual-Focus CLs
episodes.description: The low-dose atropine trials, the optical interventions, and the combined approach evidence.

episodes.title: Pediatric Contact Lenses: Age, Maturity, and Modality
episodes.description: The daily disposable first philosophy, the parent-child counseling, and the safety profile.

episodes.title: Amblyogenic Periods: When the Window Closes
episodes.description: The plasticity curve, the late treatment question, and the adult amblyopia research horizon.

episodes.title: Pediatric Eye Trauma: The Fireworks, the Pencil, the Airbag
episodes.description: The open globe signs, the subtle hyphema, and the non-accidental trauma you must consider.

episodes.title: Stargardt Disease: The Inherited Macular Dystrophy of Youth
episodes.description: The pisciform flecks, the dark choroid on FA, and the genetic counseling and low vision support.

episodes.title: Pediatric Low Vision: Maximizing the Classroom
episodes.description: Magnification, the seating placement, the assistive technology, and the IEP advocacy role.

episodes.title: Transitioning to Adult Care: The Pediatric Handoff
episodes.description: The transition planning for chronic pediatric eye disease — the records, the adherence, the continuity.
